found_after_the_run._search_0328: Then a search of all 162 accepted drop-F variants (107 here, 55 of Phase 4) for requests whose verb implies a state of its object (hide, unarchive, archive, invite, reopen, ...), at 03:28, before any underspecified verdict. A variant is degenerate when that implied state excludes an intended match (not merely a near miss). Two more, below. All three are noted and kept in the order (amendment 2's exclusion rule is the pre-run review; changing it after reading trials would bias the cells); the decisions report their sensitivity.
